How to play

Games are detected automatically in these folders:

/storage/emulated/0/<game>
/storage/emulated/0/Download/<game>

Each game folder must contain System40.ini or AliceStart.ini.

If your game is stored somewhere else, tap the + button and choose the game folder (or a parent folder containing game folders).

If the app asks for storage access, allow "All files access".
